channel.title: The GW Hatchet - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The GW Hatchet (gwhatchet.com)

item.title: University to relocate administrative offices to 2001 Pennsylvania Ave. over next two years
item.description: Seven administrative units will move from their current offices to 2001 Pennsylvania Ave., which officials purchased in 2024 for $35 million.

item.title: GW Dining announces partnership with sustainable food research collaborative
item.description: GW Dining announced a partnership with Menus of Change University Research Collaborative, a global network of colleges and universities that aims to study and encourage healthier and more sustainable eating habits at University dining halls, earlier this month.

item.title: Men’s basketball powers past George Mason 72-53 behind Hunger’s scoring surge
item.description: Men’s basketball delivered one of its most complete performances of the season Friday night, defeating George Mason 72-53 in a crosstown rivalry matchup at the Smith Center.

item.title: Women’s basketball stifled in 67-52 loss to La Salle
item.description: Women’s basketball fell 67-52 to La Salle on Saturday in the Smith Center, as a decisive third-quarter drought that turned a competitive game into a double-digit deficit.

item.title: Pentagon weighs cutting active-duty tuition aid at GW over alleged anti-military bias
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth in an internal memo labeled GW as one of the universities at a “moderate to high risk” of losing graduate military tuition assistance for the 2026-27 academic year.

item.title: Crumbs & Whiskers temporarily closes DC branch amid unionization effort
item.description: Last week’s closure comes roughly a month after Crumbs & Whiskers D.C. staff launched a unionization effort, seeking voluntary recognition.

item.title: Men’s basketball lands Italian forward
item.description: Italian forward Elisee Assui committed to GW in the 2026 recruiting class, according to DraftExpress.

item.title: Softball alum Elana Meyers Taylor wins Olympic bobsled gold
item.description: Former softball shortstop and pitcher Elana Meyers Taylor captured a gold medal for Team USA in the women’s monobob competition at the Winter Olympics on Monday afternoon.

item.title: Faculty senators press officials for transparency on budget cuts, academic mission impact
item.description: Faculty senators called on officials to provide greater transparency around the process for budget-cut decisions and the broader impact those moves could have on GW’s academic mission at a meeting Friday.

item.title: Late-game collapse sinks men’s basketball in 89-75 loss to VCU
item.description: Men's basketball's second half woes continued in 89-75 loss to VCU on Tuesday.
